summary: Implemented App.call_from_thread in src/textual/app.py: runs a callback (awaiting it if async) on the app's event loop from another thread via asyncio.run_coroutine_threadsafe, blocks for the result, and raises RuntimeError if called from the app's own thread. The app records its loop and thread id in _process_messages. Added tests/test_call_from_thread.py with 3 tests; all pass when run with PYTHONPATH pointing at the generated src (the shared venv's textual install points at the base checkout). Wider suite (excluding snapshot, devtools, cli): 608 passed, 68 failed. The failures trace to missing pytest-asyncio (async fixtures not run) and missing aiohttp (devtools); I did not run a baseline against unmodified code to confirm. Nothing committed.
